insights.one_liner: ATM Oirschot is a metal surface-treatment specialist since 1986, doing anodizing and cleanroom cleaning, with one job near Eindhoven.

culture.text: Specialised since 1986 in post-treatment of metal products: anodizing, hard anodizing, pickling, passivation, chromating and cleanroom cleaning and packing.
